title: Rename NativeSandboxControl to NodeSandboxControl
description:
Rename the NativeSandboxControl package from internal/sandbox/control/native/ to internal/sandbox/control/node/ and update the type name from NativeSandboxControl to NodeSandboxControl. Update all references across the codebase.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

This is a prerequisite for both plan 19 (Direct Adapter) and plan 20 (Fleet Management) which reference the new name.
